newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 13.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 13.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and People News.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - A poster advertising campaign by Australia for mineral water brand Contrex won the weekly IPSOS/Strategies award for the most noticed campaign. The posters showed pools of water taking the shape of a figure-hugging dress on a blue background with the slogan: "Contrex -- my slimming partner". (Strategies)

PARIS - Computer company Compaq chose Ammirati Puris Lintas as its sole world advertising agency. Bates, Compaq's previous agency, loses a contract worth at least 380 million francs ($65.1 million).(Strategies)
PARIS - Euro RSCG BETC picks Olympic high jump champion Jean Galfione to promote the latest Gemey perfume, XXL by Daniel Hechter. (Strategies)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET

PARIS - Jean-Marie Messier, chairman of France's Cie Generale des Eaux, rules out buying TF1, a rival to its indirectly-controlled pay TV unit Canal Plus in an interview with daily newspaper Liberation published on Friday. (Reuter)

PARIS - French Culture and Communication Minister Catherine Trautmann has asked for a review after three months of a youth station which state-controlled Radio-France is to launch on June 17, one of her advisers says. (Reuter)
PARIS - Cie Generale des Eaux boss Jean-Marie Messier confirms his intention to find new owners for his group's two weekly news magazines, l'Express et du Point. (Le Figaro)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

PARIS - French fashion house Chanel buys control of upmarket beachwear manufacturer Eres, a spokeswoman for Chanel says. Eres is a family-run business that generates 60 million francs in annual sales, roughly two-thirds of that in France and the rest abroad. (Reuter)
MADRID - Spanish beverage firm Larios says it decides to accept a buy-out offer from French drinks group Pernod Ricard.(Reuter)
PEOPLE NEWS:

PARIS - Bertrand de Lestapis is appointed chairman of Mediapolis France, which buys space for Havas Advertising and Young & Rubicam. He was previously managing director of Mediapolis France, which bought space worth 4.4 million francs in 1996.(Reuter)
PARIS - Bernard Exbrayat, Bruno Japy, Jean-Pierre Busson, Laurent Giraux and Jane Tracy are named creative directors at McCann-Erickson France. (Reuter)
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
